assessment_objectives.objective: Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) are developed to assist senior management in performance monitoring, trend analysis and possible control redesign or replacement for the organization's Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP).
Key Risk Indicator (KRI) results are reported to senior management per an organization-defined frequency.
Key Risk Indicator (KRI) results are used to identify Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP) controls that may require redesign or replacement.
